title: Party to the contract must not impose disproportionate penalties
description: A party to the contract must not impose penalties on the consumer that are wholly disproportionate to the loss occurred due to breach

conditions: penalties must be proportionate to the loss
limitations: penalty must not be wholly disproportionate to the loss occurred due to breach of contract
